dataList.title:
探索地下二层
 Explore B2F
dataList.description:
我们抵达了地下二层。继续前进吧。
 We've reached B2F. Let's keep moving.

steps.goalDescription1:
探索地下二层
 Explore B2F

dataList.title:
前往丝绞巢
 Head to the Skein Nest
dataList.description:
我们来到了地下二层。克罗默的姐姐提到过一个叫"丝绞巢"的地方。往左走吧。
 We've made it down to B2F. Kromer's older sister mentioned a place called the Skein Nest. Let's head to the left.

steps.goalDescription1:
向左前往丝绞巢
 Head to the Skein Nest to the Left

dataList.title:
离开洗手间
 Leave the Restroom
dataList.description:
我们试图前往丝绞巢，但一只巨大的怪物追上来把我们杀了。它似乎是冲着我们携带的金色蚕茧来的。眼下先离开洗手间，另想办法通过。
 We tried to reach the Skein Nest, but a massive monster chased us down and killed us. It seemed to be after the Golden Cocoon we're carrying. For now, let's leave the Restroom and figure out another way through.

steps.goalDescription1:
离开洗手间
 Leave the Restroom

dataList.title:
前往丝绞巢（2）
 Head to the Skein Nest (2)
dataList.description:
那怪物似乎暂时离开了。趁这个机会再冲一次丝绞巢吧。
 Looks like the monster has stepped away for the moment. Let's use this chance to make another run for the Skein Nest.

steps.goalDescription1:
返回前往丝绞巢
 Head Back to the Skein Nest

dataList.title:
与地下二层楼层经理交谈
 Talk to B2F's Floor Manager
dataList.description:
我们安全抵达了丝绞巢。地下二层楼层经理就在这里。去问问金色蚕茧能不能纺成金丝线吧。
 We made it safely to the Skein Nest. B2F's Floor Manager is here. Let's ask whether the Golden Cocoon can be spun into Golden Thread.

steps.goalDescription1:
与地下二层楼层经理交谈
 Talk to the B2F's Floor Manager

dataList.title:
前往染坊
 Head to the Dyehouse
dataList.description:
楼层经理说要做出金丝线需要金色染料。染坊里有位叫帕莱特的人应该能帮上忙。我们该从走廊出去，往上走去找染坊。
 The Floor Manager says Golden Dye is needed to make Golden Thread. Someone named Palette in the Dyehouse should be able to help. We should leave through the corridor, then head upward to find the Dyehouse.

steps.goalDescription1:
前往染坊
 Head to the Dyehouse

dataList.title: 소문 수집/미사용
dataList.description:
偷听一下正在干活的顾客们，搜集些情报吧。
 Let's eavesdrop on the customers at work and gather information.

steps.goalDescription1:
询问干活的顾客
 Ask a Working Customer

询问干活的顾客
 Ask a Working Customer

dataList.title:
找到裸者并交涉
 Find Naked and Negotiate
dataList.description:
等待金色染料的队伍长得离谱。据说有个叫裸者的漆黑者排在最前面。去找裸者谈谈，看能不能商量把他排队的位置让出来。
 The wait for Golden Dye is absurdly long. Apparently, a Noir named Naked has the earliest place in line. Let's find Naked and see if we can negotiate for his place in the queue.

steps.goalDescription1:
找到裸者并交涉
 Find Naked and Negotiate

询问排队的漆黑者
 Ask the Queued Noir

dataList.title:
向帕莱特打听"L'Incolore"染料
 Ask Palette for L'Incolore Dye
dataList.description:
裸者根本没打算白白让出金色染料。他愿意用一种叫"L'Incolore"的染料来交换。回去问问帕莱特能不能做出这种染料。
 Naked has no intention of giving up the Golden Dye for free. He'll trade it for a dye called L'Incolore instead. Let's return to Palette and ask if she can make some.

steps.goalDescription1:
向帕莱特打听"L'Incolore"染料
 Ask Palette for L'Incolore Dye

dataList.title:
在染料仓库戳破眼泪
 Burst the Tears at the Dye Storage
dataList.description:
幸好帕莱特说她能立刻做出"L'Incolore"。作为交换，她要我们去戳破不同颜色的眼泪。据说右边的染料仓库里就能找到。收集2份黄色、2份红色和2份蓝色染料，再带回去给帕莱特。
 Luckily, Palette says she can make L'Incolore right away. In exchange, she wants us to burst Tears of different colors. They can apparently be found in the Dye Storage to the right. Collect 2 Yellow, 2 Red, and 2 Blue Dye, then bring them back to Palette.

steps.goalDescription1:
收集黄色染料
 Collect the Yellow Dye
steps.goalDescription2:
收集红色染料
 Collect the Red Dye
steps.goalDescription3:
收集蓝色染料
 Collect the Blue Dye

steps.goalDescription1:
把染料带给帕莱特
 Bring the Dyes to Palette

dataList.title:
与裸者交换金色染料
 Trade with Naked for Golden Dye
dataList.description:
帕莱特把"L'Incolore"给了我们。我完全看不出它有什么颜色，不过……带去给裸者，看他愿不愿意用金色染料交换吧。
 Palette gave us the L'Incolore. I can't see any color in it at all, but... let's bring it to Naked and see if he'll trade us the Golden Dye.

steps.goalDescription1:
用"L'Incolore"跟裸者交换金色染料
 Trade L'Incolore for Golden Dye with Naked

dataList.title: 황금염료/미사용
dataList.description:
我们该去帕莱特那儿领取金色染料了。
 We should collect the Golden Dye from Palette.

steps.goalDescription1:
从帕莱特处领取金色染料
 Collect the Golden Dye from Palette

dataList.title:
返回地下二层楼层经理处
 Return to the B2F Floor Manager
dataList.description:
多亏奥提斯口若悬河的交涉，裸者终于同意交出金色染料。把它带给地下二层楼层经理吧。
 Thanks to Outis's eloquent requisition effort, Naked finally agreed to hand over the Golden Dye. Let's take it to the B2F Floor Manager.

steps.goalDescription1:
返回地下二层楼层经理处
 Return to the B2F Floor Manager

dataList.title:
击退入侵者
 Hold off the Intruders
dataList.description:
就在我们等待金色蚕茧被纺成丝线时，走廊那边传来了有人靠近的声音。他们多半是冲着金丝线来的。在纺丝完成之前，守住走廊入口。
 While we were waiting for the Golden Cocoon to be spun into thread, we heard the sound of someone approaching from the corridor. They are probably after the Golden Skein. Hold the corridor entrance until the spinning is complete.

steps.goalDescription1:
击退入侵者
 Hold off the Intruders

dataList.title:
领取做好的金丝线
 Collect the Completed Golden Skein
dataList.description:
那不明生物已经被击倒了。回去找地下二层楼层经理，领取做好的金丝线吧。
 The unknown creature is down. Let's return to the B2F Floor Manager and collect the finished Golden Skein.

steps.goalDescription1:
从地下二层楼层经理处领取做好的金丝线
 Collect the Finished Golden Skein from the B2F Floor Manager

dataList.title:
离开地下二层
 Leave B2F
dataList.description:
我们拿到了做好的金丝线。看来这里的事已经办完了。是时候离开地下二层了。
 We have the finished Golden Skein. Looks like we're done here. Time to leave B2F.

steps.goalDescription1:
离开地下二层
 Leave B2F

dataList.title:
前往三楼
 Head to 3F
dataList.description:
该上三楼看看金丝线能不能织成金布了。
 Time to head up to 3F and see if the Golden Skein can be woven into Golden Fabric.

steps.goalDescription1:
搭乘扶梯前往三楼
 Take the Escalator to 3F
